clean: The house at the end of Maple Street had been empty for as long as anyone could remember, but every evening at dusk a single light came on in the attic window. The children dared each other to go and look. Nobody ever did, until one October night a girl named Nell, who was new in town and did not know any better, walked right up to the front door and knocked. She heard footsteps, slow ones, coming down the stairs, and when the door creaked open there was nobody there, just a cold draught and the smell of old cinnamon, and a voice from somewhere above that said, "We're late."

End of week thoughts for the shop. Sales were up about 10% which is great. A new display by the window is clearly working, people keep coming in to ask about the blue stars, so I should order more of those. The delivery from the supplier was late again though, I need to have a proper talk with them, maybe find a second supplier just in case. Also hire someone for Saturdays, I cannot keep doing the whole day alone, my feet are killing me. And I should really update the website, the opening hours on it are wrong.
